title: About us — Supreme Art
description: Supreme Art makes pharmaceutical cartons, labels and leaflets in Pakistan on Heidelberg, Bobst and hot-stamping machinery, with specialised security coatings.

intro.heading: The paper box your medicine comes in, made with care on remarkable machines.
paragraphs: Every carton that leaves Supreme Art (Pvt) Ltd begins as a promise to the patient who will one day open it. We keep that promise on machinery chosen for its precision: Heidelberg Speedmaster presses laying down five colours and a coat in a single pass, Bobst die-cutters and folder-gluers that shape each box true to its lines, a hot-stamping machine that sets foil into the board, colour-shifting seals that guard against imitation, and a high-quality carton inspection machine keeping watch over the work.

We work with pharmaceutical brands who need packaging that is accurate, consistent and traceable, because for medicine the box is part of patient safety. And when the work is done, we deliver it ourselves, to every corner of Pakistan.
